title: SafePay: UPI Fraud Monitor
context: Payment networks screen transactions in real time for duplicates, bursts, unusual amounts and mule-account patterns.

milestones.title: Matching a flagged amount
milestones.requirement: Count sets of transfers totalling exactly a flagged amount (backtracking).

milestones.title: Exact-amount runs
milestones.requirement: Count consecutive runs summing exactly to a target (prefix + map).

milestones.title: Fastest Rs 50 000
milestones.requirement: Shortest burst of consecutive transactions reaching Rs 50 000.
